	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes

				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"LoteSiloId"
					&Insert_LoteSiloId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&LoteId);

LoteId = &LoteId if not &LoteId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(LoteId);
noprompt(LoteId);

LoteSiloId = &Insert_LoteSiloId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_LoteSiloId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(LoteSiloId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_LoteSiloId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditLote.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, LoteId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
DB.LoadAuditLote.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, LoteId, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditLote.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, LoteId, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditLote.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, LoteId, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;

=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditLote ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Lote
		Where LoteId = &LoteId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Lote'

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()

					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'LoteId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = LoteId.ToString()
